Sites: DNR gives 61 drive-in sites (overnight facilities) and 58 (seasonal update); ReserveMN lists 56. Written 56. Site B3's 118 ft is plainly an error; the next longest is 75 ft. 51 RV-usable sites, all 26 ft+, so a 23-ft rig fits every one.
Electric: DNR says six 30-amp sites; ReserveMN also sells '#CH32' (likely a camp-host pad) as an electric site at $34 with Amp 50. Written 30 A from the DNR; not counting CH32's 50 A.
Season (stored manual year_round with the B-loop winter note) matches ReserveMN (in season every day 2026-11-11 to 2027-11-23); not changed.
Alert (updated 2026-11-01): the trail to Minneopa Creek is closed; falls still visible from the sidewalk. Campground unaffected.
Not waterfront kept: ReserveMN gives sites .1-.3 mile to water, none 'Water Front'.
Pin 44.1595,-94.0885 is ~140 m from the ReserveMN unit centroid 44.15994,-94.08690. OK.
